svg.title: Study 304 at 6 months: more hair, more side effects on the twice-daily dose
svg.desc: Veradermics Study 304, 536 men. Gain in non-vellus hairs per square centimeter at month 6: placebo 6.6, VDPHL01 8.5 mg once daily 28.6, twice daily 36.4. Any side effect: 28.2%, 42.1%, 42.9%. Swelling of the legs or ankles (peripheral edema): 0.6%, 2.8%, 4.5%. Unwanted body or facial hair (hypertrichosis): 0%, 2.2%, 9.0%.
